property.title: Writes confined to destination coefficient array
property.candidate_statement: A frame check can target the fact that the only visible writes are to r->coeffs[i] for i in [0, MLKEM_N), with no allocation, deallocation, or explicit global-state update in the body.

supporting_evidence.supports_claim: The only visible write target is the destination coefficient array.
The API exposes a mutable destination pointer and a const-qualified source pointer.

required_assumptions: The visible function body is complete for this symbol.
No hidden macro expansion introduces extra side effects.
out_of_scope_boundaries: Does not assert that b remains semantically unchanged under pointer aliasing.
Does not rule out shared-memory effects if r and b alias the same object.
property.uncertainty: The snapshot does not include aliasing or ownership contracts.
limitations: Semantic effects through aliasing are not ruled out.
This is a local footprint observation, not a whole-function proof.

content.selection_reason: Selected after the LLM-authored candidate set was saved and post-classified. Selection is an experiment-control decision, not proof that the property is true.

effective_property_campaign.claim_boundary: Local selected claim only; uncatalogued status does not imply truth, novelty, or provability.
